# Blink Web App Manifest Parser (`third_party/blink/renderer/modules/manifest`)

**Parent:** [WebApps Central Hub](/components/webapps/AGENTS.md)

Blink renderer-side parser converting JSON web app manifests into strongly typed
`blink.mojom.Manifest` structs for browser-process consumers.
